description: Get the criterion-by-criterion evidence report for one candidate: candidate-attributed commits, dated commercial context, domain evidence, and a screening question for every unknown. Use it on a shortlist, not on every search result: it costs 3 credits and, on a cache miss, returns a pending response you must retry after the stated delay. Supported means the stated evidence standard was met; public evidence can never establish commercial or private work.

domains.description: Domain packs to assess core subject-matter work against, max 3. One of: payments, healthcare, adtech. Without a domain, the core domain criterion comes back unknown rather than assessed.

skills.description: Skills to gather evidence for, 1 to 5 entries, e.g. ['Scala', 'Kotlin'].
